title: Digital Business Analyst
text: Digital Business Analyst at DFP Recruitment (Geelong & Great Ocean Road, ; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). This Digital Business Analyst is required to join an existing team located in the Geelong Waterfront. The role will provide a broad range of analysis services including process mapping, needs analysis, business process analysis and technical analysis. The role will be a trusted advisor and key influencer in the growth of the organisation's client and provider Digital offering, ensuring that it remain a robust and mature enterprise function. The role will be a 12 month fixed term contract. Key Responsibilities: Identify key business requirements through engagement with business stakeholders, conducting formal analysis and assessment of needs Conduct requirements prioritisation, traceability and communication Develop and make recommendations for business solutions based on sound research and analysis Support any business case development and analysis related to project initiation as required Conduct business analysis planning, and support the creation of project plans and work estimates Create and maintain strong working relationships with project stakeholders and delivery partners Key Criteria: Extensive business analysis experience within an Agile project environment Experience in the practical application of continuous improvement methodologies Knowledge and experience in a broad range of business analysis techniques Proven experience in business analysis functions including planning, requirements development and management, and solution validation Experience in project implementation support activities including work practice development, UAT and end user training delivery Experience using project management software (JIRA) Proficient in Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint Experience and knowledge of Digital products including Google Analytics is highly desirable Benefits: Access to reimbursement for gym or fitness memberships annually, as well as corporate discounts with selected gyms Flexible working arrangements Salary packaging options, including extra super contributions and novated leasing Recognition of prior service in the Public Sector for the purposes of Long Service Leave To Apply, follow the 'Apply Now' link, or contact Claire at DFP on (03) 8632 9900 Please note that applications must be received by close of business on the 27th of February to be considered. By submitting an application you agree to our Privacy and Information Collection Policy located at www.dfp.com.au
